summary: GameStop filed an 8-K reporting privately negotiated exchange agreements with holders of its 0.00% convertible senior notes due 2030 and 2032. The company will exchange approximately $400 million of 2030 notes and $1.0 billion of 2032 notes for Class A common stock, with no cash proceeds. The exchange reduces long-term debt by about $1.4 billion, leaving $1.1 billion of 2030 and $1.7 billion of 2032 notes outstanding. Shares issued are based on a 35-day VWAP with a price floor. Closing is expected around September 23, 2026, with termination rights after September 30. This debt-for-equity conversion reduces leverage and dilutes existing shareholders, though it is not a typical capital return. Watch for the final exchange price and any open-market hedging by noteholders.
